Hi Thomas,

Thanks for getting in touch, and good question to ask before you order rather than after.

On the listing itself, the Harlo B30 is $899 USD for the one variant we sell (US / UK / EU plug matched to your address), with shipping calculated at checkout from your address. So the $939 you are seeing is the unit plus shipping rather than a different price for the miner.

On the UK tax point I do not want to give you a half answer, because it is money. Our general UK line is that orders to the UK may attract VAT and duty on delivery and that those are the recipient's, but the prepaid wording you have read is newer than that, and which applies to a B30 going to mainland UK depends on which warehouse it leaves from. A colleague is picking that up today and will come back on this thread with a straight yes or no, plus the figure if anything is payable on delivery. You will have it before you need to commit to anything.

One thing worth knowing while you wait: the B30 is a pre-sale unit and ships October 30, 2026.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
